_comment: Where each environment's /api traffic goes. api_platform 'vercel': the API's Python functions in the web project itself (tools/build_api_functions.py), with each context in 'services' answered by its own function and everything else by 'all'. api_platform 'render': the single API at 'api'. frontend/vercel.json is generated from this file by tools/gen_gateway.py; never edit its rewrites or functions by hand. 'hukamnama_api' (Vercel functions only): the public Hukamnama API's origin; where it is set, /{lang}/hukamnama pages , the /feeds/hukamnama.xml and .json feeds and /sitemap-hukamnama.xml are rendered by the 'all' function from that API (webapp/hukamnama_page.py, hukamnama_feed.py, hukamnama_sitemap.py), and where it is absent those paths stay with the static site.
